format_notice: Prepared handoff metadata; not an official platform import schema.
name: Ultiwrite

mcp.authorization: user-delegated OAuth authorization code with PKCE S256

tools.name: ultiwrite_capabilities_get
tools.purpose: Current capabilities, inputs, limits and terms

tools.name: ultiwrite_account_get
tools.purpose: Identity from the authorized account grant

tools.name: ultiwrite_case_status
tools.purpose: Actual case state and required next action

tools.name: ultiwrite_evidence_submit
tools.purpose: Authorized evidence submission, upload handoff or case continuation

tools.name: ultiwrite_findings_get
tools.purpose: Saved findings, pagination and supported long-field spans

first_release_agent_target: Authenticated Agentforce Employee agent with per-user OAuth
host_auth_blocker: Test Salesforce public PKCE exchange against token auth method none; no confidential secret is currently advertised.

evidence_submission_contract.original_files_rule: When the host exposes supported original file objects, forward those objects unchanged as files, with caseId:null, handoffId:null and the authorized documentForensics choice.
evidence_submission_contract.recovery_rule: Retain the exact returned handoffId. After browser upload confirms receipt, call ultiwrite_evidence_submit with files:[], caseId:null, handoffId:returnedHandoffId, documentForensics:null to recover the exact saved case. Do not infer the case from a newest-case list.
evidence_submission_contract.continuation_rule: Only when requested by the server, call ultiwrite_evidence_submit with files:[], caseId:returnedCaseId, handoffId:null, documentForensics:null.
evidence_submission_contract.availability_rule: Candidate contract 0.9.2 is prepared from the pinned source. Source and packaging do not prove deployed runtime availability or a completed platform host test. Verify the live schema before claiming the workflow works.
